title: oncoba tettensis var. macrophylla

It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oncoba tettensis var. macrophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used to treat various health conditions.
